scientific_integrity: The complete claim has a deterministic combinatorial proof and independently implemented finite checks; the universal quantification relies on the proof, not finite enumeration. No independent audit or independent certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only whole-power deletions P^k from P^m with pairwise distinct letters of P are classified; no embedding-fiber multiplicities, arbitrary deleted words, or partial blocks are covered. Prior unindexed equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
title: Cyclic-descent classification of complements of repeated permutation words
